column1: # Expected import edges for the dotnet fixture.
# from<TAB>to, one per line. scripts/check.sh asserts this set exactly:
# a missing line is an edge the extractor stopped finding, an extra line
# is an edge it invented. Both are regressions.
# The fixture and an independent list of the edges it should produce were
# written separately, then reconciled. Every disagreement was read back
# against the source; the ones that were the extractor being wrong are
# fixed, and this file is what survived.
# Regenerate deliberately, never reflexively - the point of the file is
# that it does not move when the extractor changes.
# C# edges. A `using` names a namespace, so each C# edge below runs from the
# file with the using to every file that DECLARES that namespace; nothing is
# matched on a file name. The csproj -> csproj edges are ProjectReferences.
# What the namespace edges deliberately do NOT include:
#   TelemetryStartup.cs -> Storage/Telemetry.cs    a basename is not a namespace
#   TelemetryStartup.cs -> Options.cs (either one) no namespace is called Options
#   Bootstrap.cs        -> anything                Archived and Generated appear
#                                                  only in a comment and a string
#   anything            -> Core/Decoys.cs          the usings that name its
#   anything in System.*, Microsoft.*, Serilog, Newtonsoft.Json, Xunit
